Subject: Internal prep: exec readout choreography, decision rubric, and escalation path

Team — final internal prep ahead of Medsphere readout on Dec 14 (I’ll send the calendar invite with attendees). Key points for our briefing: 

1) Readout agenda (8 slides, 30 min)
- Slide 1: Objective & timetable (30s)
- Slide 2: POC scope & test corpus (1m)
- Slide 3: Data & security posture (2m)
- Slide 4: Performance results (latency, correctness) (6m)
- Slide 5: Business impact (retrieval gains, time savings) (4m)
- Slide 6: Risks & mitigations (3m)
- Slide 7: Recommended decision (go / conditional go / no-go) and rationale (3m)
- Slide 8: Next steps & contracting path (1m)

2) Go/no-go rubric (short)
- Go: all critical success metrics met AND procurement signals commercial feasibility
- Conditional go: metrics close to thresholds with mitigations + time-boxed remediation plan
- No-go: one or more critical metrics failed with no viable remediation in timeline

3) Escalation / fallback
- If legal requires additional data residency guarantees, propose a short-term Dedicated deployment pilot and pause production expansion until legal guidance is finalized.

4) Owners for the readout
- Marissa: lead deck and speak to metrics
- Aditya: be prepared to answer infra/security questions and show evidence snapshot
- Jordan: be ready to discuss SOW timeline and contracting next steps
- Hannah: chair the meeting and the decision ask

Please confirm you have the slides and deliverables uploaded to the shared drive by EOD Dec 12. I’ll circulate final slide deck and the exact attendee list after we lock the calendar invite.

Thanks — let’s be crisp and keep the ask focused.

Hannah
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
